# Bare www literals

www.example.com

Visit www.example.com for it.

Visit www.example.com.

Visit www.example.com, then wait.

Visit www.example.com/path?q=1 today.

Upper case: WWW.example.com here.

Mixed case: Www.example.com here.

- In a list item, www.example.com.

> In a blockquote, www.example.com.

Not in a code span: `www.example.com`.

Not in an autolink: <http://www.example.com>.

Not as a destination: [visit](http://www.example.com).

In link text: [www.example.com](http://www.example.com).

In brackets: [www.example.com] here.

After brackets: [x] www.example.com here.

After an unclosed bracket: [x www.example.com here.

One segment after the prefix: www.example here.

Nothing after the prefix: www. here.

Prefix alone at the end: www.

Underscore in the last segment: www.example.co_m here.

Underscore in the second last segment: www.ex_ample.com here.

Underscore in an earlier segment: www.e_x.example.com here.

Letter before: xwww.example.com here.

Digit before: 1www.example.com here.

After a slash: path/www.example.com here.

After a colon: see:www.example.com here.

After an opening parenthesis: (www.example.com) here.

After an asterisk: *www.example.com* here.

After an underscore: _www.example.com_ here.

After a tilde: ~www.example.com~ here.

Emphasis inside: **www.example.com** here.

Parenthesis inside: www.example.com/a_(b) here.

Unbalanced parenthesis: www.example.com/a) here.

Trailing dots: www.example.com... here.

Two on a line: www.example.com and www.example.org.

Inside a URL: https://www.example.com here.

Before an angle bracket: www.example.com<b> here.

Hyphen in the domain: www.my-example.com here.

Only two w: ww.example.com here.

Four w: wwww.example.com here.

An email that starts with www: www.alex@example.com here.

Escaped dot: www\.example.com here.
